typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' adapted for heavy civil operations. High legibility in direct sunlight, industrial strength, and extreme clarity.

headings.description: Industrial, sturdy, highly legible under harsh conditions.
headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1-H3. Never center-align by default.

body.description: Technical, precise, and easily readable for dense data tables and forms.
body.usage: Use leading-relaxed for long text, tracking-normal for standard inputs.

mono.description: For IDs, timestamps, and Trust Spine hashes.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro (Adapted for Heavy Civil / Field-First)
colors.description: High-contrast, tactical, and glare-resistant. Optimized for mud, bright sunlight, and quick scanning. Teal green/blue is strictly forbidden.

rules.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/overlays.
rules.hover_states: Hover states must be explicitly defined and have HIGHER contrast than default.

visual_enhancers.borders: Hard, 1px or 2px solid borders. No soft shadows. Use sharp edges or max 4px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat solid backgrounds with borders. Avoid glassmorphism as it fails in sunlight. Use solid colored backgrounds (e.g., bg-white) with border-b for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Expose the skeleton for data-heavy views. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadow for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - crisp, recognizable, solid weights for high visibility.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI base, heavily customized for 'field-first' operations.

buttons.touch_targets: Massive. Minimum h-12 (48px) to h-14 (56px) for primary actions. Glove-friendly.
buttons.style: Rectangular, dense, solid background. No pill shapes. 1px border on secondary buttons.

forms.inputs: Minimum h-12. Avoid native inputs, use customized Shadcn Input/Select. Prefill wherever possible. Minimize typing.
forms.validation: Error states must clearly explain: What happened? Why? What next? (No vague messages).

tables.style: Border-collapse layout. Dense but clear row height. Zebra striping (bg-zinc-50) for readability in sunlight.
tables.mobile: On mobile, transform tables into stackable cards for vertical scrolling.

status_chips.style: Solid background with contrasting text and an accompanying icon (never rely on color alone).

dialogs.style: Full-screen on mobile, centered modal on desktop. Always include explicit 'Cancel' and 'Confirm' buttons.
dialogs.confirmation: Must show 'What changed', 'When', 'By whom', and 'Evidence reference' for Trust Spine correlation.

toasts.position: top-center on mobile for immediate visibility, bottom-right on desktop.

grids.strategy: High Density Grid for Dashboards, Linear Vertical for Mobile Forms.
grids.desktop: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column subgrid. gap-4 or gap-6.
grids.mobile: Strictly grid-cols-1. Stack everything. Full-width touch targets.

layouts.navigation: Sticky top header with solid background (bg-white border-b border-zinc-200). Bottom tab bar for mobile (thumb-friendly). No hamburger-only menus on desktop.
layouts.page_anatomy: Header -> Breadcrumbs -> Title/Action Bar -> Content -> Footer.
layouts.spacing: Generous container padding (p-4 to p-8) but tight relational spacing within widgets (gap-2 to gap-4) to maximize viewport usage.

rules: Use micro-interactions for button presses (scale down slightly).
Immediate visual response to taps (bg color change).
Use loading skeletons (progressive loading) instead of spinners where possible.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-daily-report-button').
accessibility.vision: Do not rely on color alone for status. Always pair with text/icons.
accessibility.contrast: Enforce strict WCAG AA or APCA contrast ratios. Text over backgrounds must be fully legible in direct sunlight.
accessibility.keyboard: Full keyboard navigation required for desktop operators (estimators/executives).

media.strategy: Utilitarian. Photos used as evidence or reference, not decoration.
media.images: Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.

image_urls.description: Curated images for heavy civil operations (Daily Reports, Photos, Dispatch, Equipment). DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDERS.

3d_libraries.strategy: None for the core field operator application. The focus is speed and cognitive ease.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are executing WP-16 (OPERATOR EXPERIENCE CONSTITUTION). The platform must feel invisible, allowing the work to command attention.
Enforce Field-First Hardening: All controls must be glove-friendly (large touch targets, min h-12) and sunlight-readable (high contrast, light mode).
Never use `transparent` background in headers, sticky elements, or overlays. Use solid backgrounds with borders (e.g., `bg-white border-b border-zinc-200`).
Implement the 'Golden Path' UI: Reduce clicks, avoid duplicate entries, prefer pickers over typing.
Error Messages: Every error MUST answer 'What happened?', 'Why?', and 'What next?'. Never expose stack traces or vague messages.
Trust Spine Visibility: Important actions must show confirmation with evidence (What changed, When, By Whom, Evidence Ref).
No feature ships without an operator walkthrough setup (conceptually). Keep layouts predictable and rigid.
Mobile Experience: Stack everything. Use bottom navigation bars if necessary. No complex horizontal scrolling.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, link, form input, and status chip.
Do NOT make it prettier for its own sake. Optimize for correctness, clarity, and operations-first efficiency.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use simplistic gradients or centered layouts.
Use solid background headers. NO glassmorphism—it looks muddy in direct sunlight.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties (`transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
DO NOT center align the app container. Text and forms should align left for natural reading flow.
Use modern but rugged UI components—sharp corners or max 4px radius, no pill shapes.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Do not use placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided 'image_urls' for dummy data.
Use 'sonner' for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .tsx if applicable, adjust based on actual file extensions).
Check components in src/components/ui before creating new ones. Build on Shadcn primitives.
